name: Hall Assembly with a Cornered Maximal Recovered Seed
definition: Let $H$ be Hall's 299-concept obstruction, set $S=H\cup\{373\}$, and use the compatible Hall repair tips $a=183$ and $b=315$. On a new coordinate $p$, form $X=((S\cup\{b\})\times\{0\})\cup((S\cup\{a\})\times\{1\})$.
parameters: $S$ has 300 concepts in dimension 12, while $X$ has 602 concepts in dimension 13.
properties: The seed $S$ is an ample forbidden pc-minor with corners 373 and 1011. In $X$, the new layer coordinate is the only balanced coordinate, its singleton is the unique maximal successful layer set, and the recovered seed is $S$. Thus maximal recovery need not produce a cornerless seed. The assembly corners are $315,373,1011,4279,4469,5107$; deleting either layer copy 373 or 4469 yields an ample forbidden pc-minor, with all 39 elementary images explicitly peeled in each case.
